A Firm Committed to Excellence
Silvercrest: A Firm Committed to Excellence

Our goal is to provide unparalleled advice to every client. Alongside our modern approach to portfolio construction, we offer the personalized service and open communication larger organizations can't, so clients feel confident and secure in choosing Silvercrest.

Since our founding we have proudly served individuals and families with significant financial assets. We have a history of successfully dealing with such issues as diversifying from concentrated stock holdings or privately held assets, investing family foundations and endowments; business succession planning; investing for retirement, and estate and tax planning.

Asset management is in our name. For over a decade, Silvercrest has partnered with select institutional clients to provide asset management, through our proprietary long-only equity management capabilities. We manage small through large cap value and growth equity, and international value strategies.

Silvercrest partners with endowments, foundations and family offices to provide customized, full-service investment office solutions. The firm’s outsourced chief investment officer (OCIO) team leverages decades of experience managing nonprofits and family offices in tailoring portfolios to its clients’ distinctive financial goals, risk tolerances and mission objectives.

In this issue of Insights, our team explores some of the most consequential forces shaping today’s markets and economy: the structure of the AI buildout, the philosophy of portfolio construction, and the geopolitical shifts reshaping how capital is deployed around the world.

A Trusted Partner for Endowments & Foundations
OCIO Solutions for Institutional Portfolios
Silvercrest offers outsourced chief investment officer (“OCIO”) solutions to foundations, endowments and other institutions with long term investment time horizons.

Understanding a client’s true risk tolerance is essential, as the primary risk is always a portfolio decline that leads to panicked selling and which can prevent the institution from achieving its long-term mission. Silvercrest's experienced team of portfolio managers, manager research analysts and risk advisors have decades of experience advising a number of America’s largest endowed charities and the world’s most sophisticated global investors. Our team’s process focuses on understanding each client’s mission and long-term financial objective along with its portfolio preferences regarding risk, return, complexity, liquidity, mission-alignment and cost. The next step is to create a fully customized asset allocation and manager line-up that can achieve those goals and objectives in the most streamlined and cost-effective manner possible.
The time tested strategy of portfolio diversification continues to be an important principle for any portfolio, whether a university endowment or a family foundation.
